slides: Your body moves in cycles—use them.
A 30‑second plank wakes every core fiber.
Follow with 10 seconds of deep breaths.
Repeat three times to reset nervous tension.
Result: tighter core, calmer mind, no extra time.
The moment you pause, habit wins.
Each second you wait adds weight to the default.
Set a 5‑second rule: act before the count ends.
Your brain treats the timer as a commitment.
Take action fast, and the habit becomes your ally.
Feeling sluggish? Move, don’t coffee.
A quick 45‑second squat burst spikes adrenaline.
Adrenaline lifts glucose into muscles for fuel.
When the burst ends, mitochondria stay primed.
You get clear focus without the caffeine crash.
Your to‑do list should echo your why.
Write one purpose word beside each task.
If the word feels forced, the task misaligns.
Realign by merging, delegating, or dropping.
When tasks match values, execution feels effortless.
